Models from datasheet figures (no vendor SPICE models): see `input.py`. The converter and the LiDAR are constant-power loads (6 W, 8 W), all five relay coils on.

Suppressed load dump (ISO 16750-2 test B): the car's own suppression holds the supply at 35 V for up to 400 ms. A TVS that starts conducting below 35 V tries to hold the whole car's supply down through its fuse: far beyond its rating. One that starts above 35 V lets the 35 V through to the 60 V-rated converter and clips only the fast spikes.
